label: Constraint extraction
subgoals: Recognize differential pairs and mirrors as subgraphs of the netlist
Emit symmetry, matching and sensitive-net constraints
Let designer annotations override or add constraints

label: Placement under symmetry
subgoals: Write mirror symmetry as equal y and x coordinates summing to twice the axis
Contrast annealing over sequence pairs with analytical placement
Pre-build matched primitives with parameterized generators

label: Routing and the verification loop
subgoals: Route symmetric net pairs as mirror images with equal parasitics
Require DRC, LVS and post-layout simulation for acceptance
Feed post-layout failures back as constraints or re-sizing
